title: Nutty Buttery Ukrainian Noodle Pilaf
description: A buttery and aerated Ukrainian noodle dish featuring red onions and nuka-pickle, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced red onion and cook until softened and lightly browned.
Add the cooked buckwheat noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and butter.
Add the chopped nuka-pickle, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the noodles are well coated.
Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter until melted and well combined.
Add the chopped walnuts to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the noodle pilaf hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
